forms/text-input.title: Text input
forms/text-input.intro: TextInput is the workhorse field for single-line strings — titles, slugs, emails, and numeric values. Orbit wraps native inputs with consistent label, hint, helper, prefix/suffix affixes, and validation rules that dehydrate with the form. Variants below show type modifiers, affix chrome, and interaction states you can combine on one field.

variants.heading: Basic text input
variants.blurb: Label, placeholder, and helper text — the default starting point.
variants.code: TextInput.make('title').label('Title').placeholder('Enter a title…').helper_text('Shown on the public page.')

variants.heading: Email
variants.blurb: Sets input type to email and adds an email validation rule.

variants.heading: Password (revealable)
variants.blurb: Password type with an optional reveal toggle for accessibility.

variants.heading: URL
variants.blurb: URL input type with built-in url validation.

variants.heading: Telephone
variants.blurb: Tel input type for phone numbers.

variants.heading: Numeric
variants.blurb: Number input with optional min/max bounds.

variants.heading: Prefix text
variants.blurb: Static text before the control — common for currency symbols.

variants.heading: Suffix text
variants.blurb: Static text after the control — units, domains, etc.

variants.heading: Prefix icon
variants.blurb: Heroicon rendered inside the affix rail.

variants.heading: Suffix icon
variants.blurb: Trailing icon affix for links, locks, or status.

variants.heading: Required
variants.blurb: Shows the required asterisk and injects a required rule.

variants.heading: Readonly
variants.blurb: Value visible but not editable — good for generated IDs.

variants.heading: Copyable
variants.blurb: Adds a one-click copy button beside the input.

variants.heading: Input mask
variants.blurb: Client-side mask pattern for structured values like card numbers.

variants.heading: Datalist suggestions
variants.blurb: Native datalist autocomplete from a string list.

variants.heading: With hint
variants.blurb: Inline hint text and optional hint icon above the control.

forms/select.title: Select
forms/select.intro: Select fields render native or searchable dropdowns with static options, grouped options, or relationship-backed search. Searchable selects add a filter input; MultiSelect extends Select with multiple selection. Options can carry descriptions when used with Radio or CheckboxList patterns.

variants.heading: Basic select
variants.blurb: Native dropdown with a static options map.

variants.heading: Searchable select
variants.blurb: Filterable list — ideal for long option sets.

forms/textarea.title: Textarea
forms/textarea.intro: Textarea captures multi-line plain text — bios, notes, and markdown source. Control height with rows or cols; autosize grows with content. MarkdownEditor and RichEditor extend Textarea for formatted content.

variants.heading: Basic textarea
variants.blurb: Default multi-line field with placeholder and helper.

variants.heading: Custom rows
variants.blurb: Explicit row count for taller editing surfaces.

forms/checkbox.title: Checkbox
forms/checkbox.intro: Checkbox renders a single boolean toggle with an inline label. Use CheckboxList when users pick many options from a set; use Toggle for on/off settings with switch styling.

variants.heading: Basic checkbox
variants.blurb: Single boolean consent or feature flag.

forms/toggle.title: Toggle
forms/toggle.intro: Toggle is a styled switch built on Checkbox semantics — same wire:model binding, different visual treatment. Pair toggles in Flex rows for compact settings panels.

forms/date-picker.title: Date picker
forms/date-picker.intro: DatePicker wraps a native date input with min/max constraints and optional non-native picker chrome. Values dehydrate as ISO date strings.

forms/date-time-picker.title: Date time picker
forms/date-time-picker.intro: DateTimePicker combines calendar date and time in one datetime-local control. Share min/max with DatePicker for scheduling windows.

forms/time-picker.title: Time picker
forms/time-picker.intro: TimePicker is a native time input for reminders, slots, and office hours. Min/max attributes bound acceptable times.

forms/file-upload.title: File upload
forms/file-upload.intro: FileUpload is a drag-and-drop uploader with image preview, circular avatar layout, optional crop/resize, and accepted MIME filters. Image and avatar presets configure accept lists and preview automatically.

variants.heading: Avatar upload
variants.blurb: Circular avatar preset with image/* accept.

forms/radio.title: Radio
forms/radio.intro: Radio presents mutually exclusive options with optional per-option descriptions and multi-column layouts. State is a single selected key.

variants.heading: With descriptions
variants.blurb: Helper copy under each option label.

variants.heading: Multi-column
variants.blurb: Grid layout for dense option sets.

forms/checkbox-list.title: Checkbox list
forms/checkbox-list.intro: CheckboxList allows many selections from a static option map. Bulk toggle adds select-all / deselect-all links; descriptions mirror Radio.

forms/tags-input.title: Tags input
forms/tags-input.intro: TagsInput manages a list of string tags with chip UI, optional datalist suggestions, and reorderable chips for manual ordering.

forms/color-picker.title: Color picker
forms/color-picker.intro: ColorPicker wraps the native color input for brand swatches and theme tokens. Values dehydrate as hex strings.

forms/money-input.title: Money input
forms/money-input.intro: MoneyInput extends TextInput with currency prefix symbols and data attributes for locale-aware formatting on the client. Choose currency codes for USD, EUR, GBP, or KES.

forms/rich-editor.title: Rich editor
forms/rich-editor.intro: RichEditor provides a TipTap-backed WYSIWYG surface with a configurable toolbar. Content dehydrates as HTML in a hidden input bound with wire:model.

variants.heading: Basic rich editor
variants.blurb: Bold, italic, link, and heading tools.

forms/markdown-editor.title: Markdown editor
forms/markdown-editor.intro: MarkdownEditor styles a Textarea for markdown source editing. Pair with a preview prime on infolists for rendered output.

forms/key-value.title: Key-value
forms/key-value.intro: KeyValue edits arbitrary string maps as editable rows with add-row actions. Empty state shows a blank row; populated state renders existing pairs.

variants.heading: Empty key-value
variants.blurb: Metadata editor with no initial rows.

forms/repeater.title: Repeater
forms/repeater.intro: Repeater repeats a nested schema for line items, addresses, or JSON arrays. Clone, reorder, collapse, and table layouts mirror Filament repeaters.

forms/builder.title: Builder
forms/builder.intro: Builder extends Repeater with typed blocks — each block has its own schema and picker button. Use for page builders, email sections, or CMS layouts.

variants.heading: Basic builder
variants.blurb: Hero and text blocks with picker.

forms/toggle-buttons.title: Toggle buttons
forms/toggle-buttons.intro: ToggleButtons render segmented radio controls styled as button groups — great for visibility, alignment, or enum-like choices with few options.

forms/morph-to-select.title: Morph-to select
forms/morph-to-select.intro: MorphToSelect pairs a type picker with a searchable id select — assign polymorphic relations (User vs Team) from one field.

forms/placeholder.title: Placeholder
forms/placeholder.intro: Placeholder renders static prose inside the schema — useful for section intros, upgrade prompts, or spacing without a bound field.

variants.heading: Basic placeholder
variants.code: Placeholder.make('note').content('This slot is reserved for future fields.')

forms/hidden.title: Hidden
forms/hidden.intro: Hidden fields dehydrate values without visible chrome — CSRF tokens, foreign keys, or serialized state. They render as plain hidden inputs and are omitted from screenshots.

variants.heading: Hidden field note
variants.blurb: Not visually captured — renders as <input type="hidden">.
variants.code: Hidden.make('token')  # value set via fill() or default

forms/one-time-code-input.title: One-time code input
forms/one-time-code-input.intro: OneTimeCodeInput optimizes for OTP and 2FA codes with autocomplete hints for password managers and SMS autofill.

forms/view-field.title: View field
forms/view-field.intro: ViewField displays read-only HTML or computed content inside a form — summaries, previews, or audit snippets without dehydrating user input.

forms/slider.title: Slider
forms/slider.intro: Slider wraps a range input with optional pip marks for volume, priority, or percentage selection.

schemas/section.title: Section
schemas/section.intro: Section groups related fields under a heading with optional description, icon, aside layout, and collapsible body. Compact mode tightens vertical rhythm for dense admin forms.

schemas/tabs.title: Tabs
schemas/tabs.intro: Tabs split a form into horizontal panels — each tab owns its own schema. Icons and badges help surface counts or status without leaving the page.

variants.heading: Tabs with badges
variants.blurb: Icons and numeric badges on tab labels.

schemas/wizard.title: Wizard
schemas/wizard.intro: Wizard guides users through sequential steps with back/next navigation and optional skip. Each step is a labeled schema chunk — ideal for onboarding or multi-page creates without route changes.

schemas/grid.title: Grid
schemas/grid.intro: Grid lays out child components in a fixed column count — pair with TextInput pairs, metric tiles, or mixed fields.

schemas/flex.title: Flex
schemas/flex.intro: Flex arranges children in a responsive row that stacks below a breakpoint. Use from_breakpoint('md') for side-by-side fields on desktop.

schemas/group.title: Group
schemas/group.intro: Group fuses fields without fieldset chrome — Filament-style inline grouping with optional column grid.

variants.heading: Basic group
variants.blurb: SKU and quantity on one row.

schemas/split.title: Split
schemas/split.intro: Split places schema columns side by side above a breakpoint — notes beside uploads, preview beside editor.

schemas/fieldset.title: Fieldset
schemas/fieldset.intro: Fieldset wraps nested fields in semantic fieldset/legend chrome — accessibility-friendly grouping for addresses and payment blocks.

schemas/callout.title: Callout
schemas/callout.intro: Callout surfaces info, success, warning, or danger messages inside a form — tips before save, destructive confirmations, or success banners.

schemas/empty-state.title: Empty state
schemas/empty-state.intro: EmptyState renders centered heading and description when lists or repeaters have no items — reuse in tables and standalone schema slots.

variants.heading: Basic empty state
variants.code: EmptyState.make().heading('No drafts').description('Create one when you are ready.')

schemas/primes.title: Primes
schemas/primes.intro: Primes are read-only display components — text badges, icons, images, and lists — for infolists and inline form summaries without editable state.
